answer: Bonfire society membership works as the check: a membership the society renews after burned effigies. A farm faking 430 aliases needs 430 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The falcon test is the price tag: 430 fakes mean 430 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The horizon signal is visible to every grader, and the ferrous ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
